fiction.title: BURN OF THE EVERFLAME
fiction.author: Penn Cole
fiction.description: The fourth book of the Kindred's Curse Saga. War, rebellion and an unlikely alliance factor into whether the future will be in darkness.

fiction.title: THE CALAMITY CLUB
fiction.author: Kathryn Stockett
fiction.description: As things get tougher during the Depression, several women look for ways to improve their circumstances.

fiction.title: TAIPEI STORY
fiction.author: R.F. Kuang
fiction.description: A Chinese American college freshman spending a summer in Taipei struggles with her family’s history.

fiction.title: THE PIRATE QUEEN
fiction.author: Ariel Lawhon
fiction.description: In 16th-century Ireland, Grace O’Malley endures betrayal and hardship before leading a fleet of ships to defend her land.

fiction.title: THE KNAVE AND THE MOON
fiction.author: Rachel Gillig
fiction.description: The second book in the Stonewater Kingdom series. A knave who is lacking his memory may help Sybil take Benji out of power.

nonfiction.title: THE COUNTERREVOLUTION
nonfiction.author: Victor Davis Hanson
nonfiction.description: The author of “The End of Everything” evaluates the influence of President Trump’s time out of office on his second term.

nonfiction.title: HOW TO EAT AN ELEPHANT
nonfiction.author: Sarah Longwell
nonfiction.description: The publisher of The Bulwark builds upon her interactions with voters to envision a modern pro-democracy movement.

nonfiction.title: PLOT TWIST
nonfiction.author: Harlan Coben
nonfiction.description: Coben, known for his suspense novels, shares stories from his childhood, inspirations for his characters and insights into his craft.

nonfiction.title: IN MY DARKEST HOUR
nonfiction.author: Dave Mustaine with Joe Layden
nonfiction.description: The lead vocalist and guitarist for Megadeth describes the turn his life took when he was diagnosed with squamous cell carcinoma.

nonfiction.title: REGIME CHANGE
nonfiction.author: Maggie Haberman and Jonathan Swan
nonfiction.description: Two White House correspondents for The New York Times delve into the first year of President Trump's second term.
